npc_wat_carter.name: Wat
npc_wat_carter.look: A stocky, bow-legged carter in his fifties with a ruddy face, a battered wide-brimmed hat, a mud-caked smock, gaiters, and a long whip over his shoulder.
npc_wat_carter.personality: Loud, cheerful and stubborn; swears at the mud and the ox in turn, and is pathetically grateful to anyone who helps.
npc_wat_carter.values: his cart, his ox, getting the cider to the inn on time
npc_wat_carter.fears: losing the load, the inn's anger
npc_wat_carter.authority: Owns the cart, the load and the ox.

relations.npc_rook_boy: Rook, the boy from the farm

npc_wat_carter.concerns: The cart's sunk to the axles in the mire with four barrels of cider aboard. Bess the ox can't shift it alone and he's pushed till he's blue.

load.text: The cart has four barrels of cider aboard, a good weight.
load.line: Four barrels of cider on her. That's the trouble: too heavy for the mud.
load.lead: Wat's cart carries four heavy barrels of cider.

help.text: Dunna's strong as an ox herself, and the boy Rook will lend a hand for a penny.
help.line: Dunna there could lift the cart on her own, near enough. And the lad'll help if you ask.
help.lead: Dunna and the boy Rook might lend a hand with Wat's cart.

npc_wat_carter.persuaded_by: anyone who'll put their back into it
npc_wat_carter.style: Loud and cheerful, with mild oaths.

samples: If you've a better notion, I'm all ears.
You've earned a barrel, friend. Well. A cup.
voice.habits: Mutters at the ox; kicks the wheel; thumbs his hat back.
voice.greeting: Wipes his brow: 'Don't suppose you've a strong back?'

goals: Get the cart out of the mire
Get the cider to the inn
npc_wat_carter.dislikes: mud, the parish for not mending the lane

npc_dunna_farmer.text: a good neighbour, strong as two men

superstition.text: Wat would want to know how it works.

npc_dunna_farmer.name: Dunna
npc_dunna_farmer.look: A tall, broad-shouldered farm woman in her thirties with a sunburnt face, a brown headscarf, a russet dress kilted up over boots, and a hay fork over her shoulder.
npc_dunna_farmer.personality: Practical, strong and impatient with fools; will help with anything that makes sense and nothing that doesn't.
npc_dunna_farmer.values: her farm, common sense, a job done right
npc_dunna_farmer.authority: Farms the field beyond the gate.
npc_dunna_farmer.concerns: Wat's cart is blocking the lane her own cart needs this afternoon. She'll help if someone has a sensible plan.

lever.text: A long rail and a stone under it will lift a wheel; boards under it will hold it.
lever.line: Get a rail under the axle, a stone under the rail, and lean. Then boards under the wheel.
lever.lead: A rail levered on a stone can lift a stuck wheel; boards stop it sinking.

voice.habits: Leans on her fork; gives orders; gets on with it.
voice.never: wastes effort on a daft plan

superstition.text: Dunna would want to know how it works.

npc_rook_boy.name: Rook
npc_rook_boy.look: A gangly boy of thirteen with a shock of black hair, a torn shirt, too-short breeches, bare muddy feet and a willow switch.
npc_rook_boy.personality: Lazy, cheeky and eager to show off his strength when someone's watching.
npc_rook_boy.values: pennies, showing off, an easy life
npc_rook_boy.concerns: Dunna wants him to mind the gate; he'd rather watch the cart, or help if it's exciting.

ox.text: Bess the ox will pull if someone leads her by the nose rope.
ox.line: Bess'll pull for anyone who holds her nose rope and talks nice.
ox.lead: Wat's ox Bess pulls if led by her nose rope.

voice.habits: Swishes his switch; boasts; does things the moment Dunna looks away.

goals: Get out of minding the gate

superstition.text: Rook would want to know how it works.
